name: gender_agreement
description: wrong noun gender / article (la problème -> le problème)

name: adjective_agreement
description: adjective doesn't agree in gender/number with its noun

name: past_participle_agreement
description: participle agreement with être, pronominal verbs, or preceding COD

name: elision
description: missing elision (de un -> d'un, je ai -> j'ai)

name: contraction_articles
description: à/de + le/les not contracted (à le -> au)

name: partitive_negation
description: partitive/indefinite article after negation (pas des -> pas de)

name: quantity_de
description: de after expressions of quantity (beaucoup des -> beaucoup de)

name: subjunctive_present
description: indicative used where subjunctive is required

name: si_clause_conditional
description: wrong tense in si-clauses (si j'aurais -> si j'avais)

name: passe_compose_vs_imparfait
description: wrong choice between passé composé and imparfait

name: prepositions_places
description: wrong preposition with cities/countries (en Paris -> à Paris)

name: verb_conjugation
description: wrong verb form for the subject/tense

name: other
description: anything that doesn't fit the tags above
